potentialConfusions.note: Both show laden workers moving between rival beckoners. Different camera and landscape distinguish images, but underlying action is intentionally same and neither proves wage competition without context.
Both textile street/tenterfield. View and scale differ, near-identical subjectfamily; no independent legal distinction.
Both redclad fleeing collector with pursuing crowd. Outdoor country-vs-market setting differs; same event family.
Small personal transaction vswide crowded market, easy scale distinction but 'last' marketday requires campaigncontext.
Both raisedhands assembly. Distinguishing cue exterior EMPTY chair versus indoor standing officeholder; comparatively closest civic pair.
